title: WeeklyPlan
description: Input schema for the propose_plan tool (declared with strict: true). Numeric ranges (dinner_count 1-7, lunch_count 0-7, positive quantities) are enforced by deterministic validators, not the schema, because strict tool use does not support numeric constraints.

week_id.description: ISO 8601 week the plan belongs to, e.g. '2026-W30'.

dinner_count.description: Number of dinners the user asked to cook this week. Validator enforces 1-7.

lunch_count.description: Number of lunches to cover, all supplied by the batch meal. 0 unless the user volunteered a count. Validator enforces 0-7.

diet_type.description: User-stated diet type (e.g. 'vegetarian'); null when none stated.

default_servings.description: Servings per meal unless a meal overrides; 1 unless the user stated otherwise.

weekly_budget_usd.description: Weekly grocery budget if the user set one this session; null otherwise.

meals.description: Exactly dinner_count meals. Exactly one meal carries batch details and exactly one different meal carries stretch details — except at dinner_count 1, where the single meal carries batch details only.

name.description: Named main dish, e.g. 'Chicken chili'. Repetition matching uses the normalized form of this name.

prep_minutes.description: Estimated prep time in minutes. Validator enforces > 0.

servings.description: Servings for this meal's cooking night. Validator enforces > 0.

batch.description: Non-null on exactly one meal: the big-batch meal-prep dish.

stretch.description: Non-null on exactly one meal (distinct from the batch meal): the stretch meal. Null on every meal when dinner_count is 1.

source_url.description: Source URL when the meal is based on a recipe found via web search; null otherwise.

user_requested_repeat.description: True only when the user explicitly asked to repeat this past meal; exempts it from the 4-week repetition rule.

ingredients.description: All ingredients, with quantities scaled to this meal's full coverage (for the batch meal: every covered lunch plus its dinner night).

total_portions.description: Total portions cooked once: (lunches_covered + 1 dinner night) x servings.

technique.description: The new cooking technique this meal introduces, named (e.g. 'braising'). Must not appear in cooked-meal technique history.

name.description: Ingredient name; merged across meals after normalization.

quantity.description: Amount in the given unit. Validator enforces > 0.

unit.description: Unit token: g, kg, oz, lb, ml, l, tsp, tbsp, cup, count, or a free-form container unit like 'can'.

estimated_price_usd.description: Good-faith typical grocery price for this quantity, USD. The weekly bill is the computed sum of these.
